title: Building Management System.
officialText:
Automatic and manual operation of the smoke control system may
alternately be done through a Building Management System (BMS) that meets the following requirements and is
approved by the Fire Department:
1. The BMS system shall be listed for UL 864 UUKL Smoke Control.
2. The BMS Control Center shall be staffed 24 hours a day by operators trained in the building’s smoke control
systems and their operation. In buildings where Fire Safety Directors are required, they shall operate the smoke
control system.
3. The control room shall be 2-hour rated construction.
4. BMS annunciation and additional control station locations shall be located in the fire command center in
accordance with Section 909.16.
